title: Storyline Day 2: OKE Pod Breakout & IMDSv2 Credential Harvesting
description: Detects Day 2 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: a compromised OKE application pod executing curl against the OCI Instance Metadata Service (169.254.169.254/opc/v2/instance/) and enumerating Kubernetes service account tokens.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Command Line' like '*169.254.169.254/opc/v2/instance/*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*169.254.169.254/opc/v2/instance/*' or msg like '*serviceaccount/token*') | stats count as breakout_hits, distinctcount('Process Name') as processes by 'Host Name', 'Process Name' | sort -breakout_hits
falsepositives: OCI Kubernetes node initialization scripts calling IMDSv2 from the host namespace rather than an application pod
investigation_notes: Verify whether the process probing 169.254.169.254/opc/v2/instance/ originated inside an application pod such as portal-web-7d9c8b.
Check Kubernetes audit logs for secret reads using the harvested service account token.
